messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need to lock the minimum ship for the telemetry console in Q2: dashboards, trace hooks, per-route cost breakdown, and basic error analytics. Customers are asking for per-route cost and trace sampling controls. thoughts?
sam: +1 on per-route cost visibility. Can we reuse the existing cost API and just surface per-route aggregates? :thinking_face:
raj: For trace hooks, my proposal: lightweight sampling config + span-level export filters. Make it a runtime opt-in so overhead is minimal.
maria: Customer asks to flag — enterprise tenants want 90d retention for traces and low-cardinality error tags on errors. Also they want the ability to disable export for sensitive routes.
sam: Implementation sketch: reuse agent v2 config, add a route-level patch that includes telemetry toggles. Example:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routes/:id
{ "telemetry": { "cost_insights": true, "trace_hook": { "sample_rate": 0.1, "include_paths": ["/api/generate"] } } }
```
elaine: UX constraint: show an "estimated monthly cost impact" beside toggles. We don't need exact dollars on MVP — a bucketed estimate (Low / Medium / High) is fine initially.
raj: Tradeoffs: accurate estimator needs token * qps model and historical histograms. Quick win is to show bucketed ranges based on recent traffic. Full $ estimates later.
maria: Launch criteria proposal: 1) route-level toggles persist and validate, 2) cost estimator within ±25% for top 10 pilot customers, 3) trace hook applied without >10% regression on p99 for typical workloads, 4) error analytics surface top-5 error classes per-route.
sam: Ownership: eng-runtime -> trace hook runtime + perf budget, eng-platform -> route API + access control, product -> UX + rollout plan. PMs please confirm.
elaine: Timeline idea: 6-week spike (investigate cost estimator + runtime hook), then a 4-week MVP delivery: dashboards + per-route toggles + bucketed estimator + basic error charts.
devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: telemetry-spike branch -> staging @ 2025-05-02T03:00Z :rocket:
raj: Security note: default trace export = off for Private/VPC customers. Also add audit logs for enabling telemetry toggles.
maria: I'll pull together a short list of 6 pilot customers (2 startups, 2 mid-market, 2 enterprise) and send to the group.
sam: I'll add the checklist to the rollout doc (ownership, perf gates, pilot list, migration notes).
elaine: Ok — I'll open the roadmap PR with the proposed milestones and attach the spike spec. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
